name: PeapodsFinance
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to flash, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a short but multi-step DeFi exploit: a Uniswap V2 flash swap, a Uniswap V3 swap to manipulate token state/pricing, an interaction with a protocol-specific rewards function, then a swap back and loan repayment. It requires understanding how the target contract miscalculates value under manipulated conditions, so it is more than a trivial bug but not a deeply complex cross-protocol attack chain.
